species: We generated tobacco (Nicotiana tabacum) plants producing a nucleus‐ or plastid‐encoded partial component of dragline silk, MaSp1 (major ampullate spidroin‐1; MaSp1‐tobacco), containing six repetitive glycine‐rich and polyalanine tandem domains.
tissue: Total soluble protein was extracted from approximately 100 mg frozen leaf tissue using Rluc‐Lysis Buffer (Promega Corporation, USA).
sample_source: Total soluble protein was extracted from approximately 100 mg frozen leaf tissue using Rluc‐Lysis Buffer (Promega Corporation, USA).
strain: Tobacco (Nicotiana tabacum cv. Petit Havana SR1) seeds were surface sterilized using 75% (v/v) ethanol for 2 min, followed by 10% (v/v) commercial bleach (Kao, Japan) for 15 min, and washed with sterile MilliQ water 5 times.
